title: Slice Preparation with Tissue Dissociation - Mouse Protocol
author: Allen Institute for Brain Science
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bq6wmzfe
materials: Slice Preparation with Tissue Dissociation - Mouse
Blue Absorbent Pads (Fischer Scientific 14-206-59 or equivalent)
If Papain is unavailable, Pronase (Sigma P6911, Roche 10165921001, Millipore 537088 or equivalent) may be used.

steps.title: Prepare 0.132M Trehalose Stock
steps.instruction: Prepare a Trehalose stock solution for later use.

substeps.instruction: Measure 200 ml MilliQ water into a clean beaker with a stir bar and stir at medium speed.
Add Trehalose and stir until fully dissolved.
Transfer to a graduated cylinder and adjust final volume to 250 ml.
Transfer to a clean 250 ml Corning bottle; store at 4˚C for up to 30 days.

steps.title: Prepare Fire-Polished Pipettes
steps.instruction: Create a set of glass pipettes with varying bore sizes using a Bunsen burner.

substeps.instruction: Set up Bunsen burner on a stand with nozzle facing upwards and adjust flame to a steady peak.
Remove the cotton filter from a 9” glass pipette.
Hold the pipette neck over the flame peak (~½” from the taper) until the glass melts, then pull the ends apart.
Discard the skinny end and gently break off the very tip of the fired end to create a small opening.
Smooth the broken glass by placing the tip in the flame for 3-second intervals.
Repeat process to create pipettes of large (~600 µm), medium (~300 µm), medium-small (~200 µm), and small (~150 µm) thickness.

steps.title: Prepare FBS Aliquots
steps.instruction: Thaw and aliquot fetal bovine serum (FBS).

substeps.instruction: Set water bath to 34˚C and thaw the FBS bottle in the bath.
Swirl the bottle every 10 minutes until completely thawed.
Remove 25 ml of FBS into a 50 ml conical tube and return the main bottle to the freezer.
Aliquot 200 µl of FBS into Eppendorf tubes; store at -20˚C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare Pronase Aliquots
steps.instruction: Prepare a 140 units/ml Pronase stock solution.

substeps.instruction: Calculate required Pronase mass: 3500 units / (# units per mg Pronase) = mg needed for 25 ml stock.
Add 25 ml MilliQ water to a beaker with a stir bar and stir at medium speed.
Weigh and add the calculated amount of Pronase.
Once dissolved, aliquot 250 µl into 1.7 ml Eppendorf tubes; store at -20˚C for up to 6 months.

steps.title: Prepare Agarose Mounting Medium
steps.instruction: Prepare a black-tinted low-melt agarose solution.

substeps.instruction: Set thermomixer to 350 rpm and 43˚C.
Tare a 500 ml beaker on a balance and add 0.5 g low melt Agarose.
Add 2-3 drops of black tattoo ink and record the final weight.
Heat in microwave for 1.5 minutes.
Add MilliQ water to bring the total weight back to the recorded weight from the second step.

steps.title: Prepare Papain Solution (Optional)
steps.instruction: Prepare a 30 U/ml Papain solution in ACSF.IT.

substeps.instruction: Calculate ACSF.IT volume: (# Units Stock Vial / 30 U final volume) = Volume ACSF.IT to add (ml).
Remove metal seal from Papain vial.
Use a 20g needle and 5 ml syringe to dispense the calculated ACSF.IT into the vial.
Invert 8-10 times to dissolve powder; vortex briefly if needed.
Place vial in a 35ºC dry oven for at least 30 minutes before digestion.

steps.title: Prepare 0.2% BSA Solution (Optional)
steps.instruction: Prepare BSA solution for use with Papain.

substeps.instruction: Add 14.75 ml ACSF.IT to a 50 ml conical tube.
Add 150 µl FBS and 100 µl 30% BSA.
Invert 4-5 times to mix.

steps.title: Setup Compresstome for Slicing
steps.instruction: Configure the compresstome and prepare buffers.

substeps.instruction: Fill ice bucket with wet ice.
Set slice thickness (default 250 µm), advance knob (approx. 20s per pass, range 0.9-1.1), and oscillation knob (audible chatter, range 2.7-3.4).
Plug in LED strips and turn on T-Cube lights.
Obtain 1L of fresh ACSF.I (less than 48h old) per mouse and place on ice.
Prepare ACSF.IT by adding 15 ml 0.132M Trehalose to a graduated cylinder.
Fill a Pyrex dish with ACSF.IT (reserve 15ml for BSA if using Papain), add stir bar, slice carriers, and oxygen diffuser stone; stir at preset mode 4 (350 RPM, no heat) on wet ice.
Place another oxygen diffuser stone in the ACSF.I bottle on ice.
Turn on Carbogen and bubble both ACSF.I and ACSF.IT for at least 10 minutes.
Place heat sink in wet ice.
Mark the mounting face of the specimen syringe with a black sharpie based on the desired slicing angle.

steps.title: Setup Perfusion System
steps.instruction: Prepare the anesthesia and perfusion equipment.

substeps.instruction: Obtain Isoflurane and attach an 18G blunt needle to the Luer connector.
Place nose cone on a Styrofoam board and a paper towel in the induction chamber.
Pour 50 ml ACSF.I into a conical tube/jar; prime the pump tubing until liquid expels from the needle.

steps.title: Anesthetize and Perfuse Mouse
steps.instruction: Perform transcardial perfusion with chilled ACSF.I.

substeps.instruction: Set oxygen to 1% and Isoflurane to 5 on the VetEquip system; place mouse in induction chamber.
Remove mouse after at least 3 minutes (once breathing is ~1/sec) and verify anesthesia via toe pinch reflex.
Switch Isoflurane flow to the nose cone and position mouse supine on the Styrofoam board.
Pin paws with 5/8’’ 25 G needles and spray body with 70% EtOH.
Cut ventral skin over thorax, snip diaphragm to open thoracic cavity, and snip both sides of the rib cage.
Snip the right atrium and insert the 18G blunt needle into the left ventricle, directing the tip toward the aorta.
Run chilled, bubbled ACSF.I via pump. Turn off Isoflurane after 10ml is pumped.
Stop pump after 25ml is pumped (liver should be cleared of blood).
Remove needles and leave oxygen on for a few minutes to clear the system.

steps.title: Brain Dissection and Trimming
steps.instruction: Extract and trim the brain for mounting.

substeps.instruction: Remove the head using Mayo scissors.
Expose the skull by making an incision from the neck to the nose and cutting through the ears.
Cut the bone using Obrien angled scissors, starting at the occipital bone and working forward above the ears and eye sockets.
Peel back frontal/parietal bones and cut the dura mater.
Remove the brain using a Freer elevator and place in a petri dish with chilled, bubbled ACSF.I.

Place brain on filter paper and use a razor/scalpel to create a flat mounting surface: remove anterior 1/3 and cerebellum for caudal-to-rostral slicing, or remove cerebellum only for rostral-to-caudal slicing.
Return brain to chilled, bubbled ACSF.I immediately.

steps.title: Mount Brain and Slice
steps.instruction: Mount the brain on the compresstome and collect slices.

substeps.instruction: Verify specimen syringe and metal holder match the compresstome number; apply superglue to the syringe tip.
Place the trimmed brain onto the superglue using a Moria spoon, ensuring it is centered.
Attach the metal holder and encase it with the heat sink.
Cover tissue with warm Agarose using a Pasteur pipette and close heat sink for 10 seconds until solidified.
Insert syringe into the compresstome bath (dorsal side up) and fill bath with ~250 ml chilled, bubbled ACSF.I.
Unlock motor, advance to the tissue edge, and set to 'single' to begin cutting.
Acquire blockface images (F1 key) before each slice.
Collect ROI slices with a paintbrush into a petri dish of chilled, bubbled ACSF.I.
Hemisect slices down the middle with a razor/scalpel.
Remove Agarose with a wide mouth Pasteur pipette and load hemispheres clockwise into a slice carousel (wells 1-6).
Upload images to LIMS after completing slicing and acquiring at least 12 images.

steps.title: Microdissection of ROI
steps.instruction: Isolate regions of interest (ROI) from the slices.

substeps.instruction: Fill a Sylgard-coated dish with 3 ml 10% 0.132M Trehalose in ACSF.I.
Place a slice in the dish under a fluorescent dissecting microscope.
Dissect ROIs using microdissecting tools and acquire a zoomed-in image of the cutouts.
Separate ROI cutouts from the rest of the tissue.
Aspirate cutouts and some ACSF using a wide bore P1000 tip into a labeled 1 ml Polystyrene tube.
Keep tubes at room temperature (or on wet ice if using Pronase).
Repeat for all desired sections and a QC sample.

steps.title: Tissue Digestion (Papain or Pronase)
steps.instruction: Dissociate the microdissected tissue into a cell suspension.

substeps.instruction: If using Papain: Remove supernatant from the sample tube, add 0.5-1 ml Papain, tap to separate tissue, and incubate in a 35ºC dry oven for 30 minutes.
If using Pronase: Prepare digestion solution by mixing 4.475 ml bubbled ACSF.I, 0.525 ml 0.132M Trehalose, and a 250 µl thawed Pronase aliquot in a 15 ml conical tube.
Remove ACSF from the sample tube (do not aspirate cutouts) and add 1 ml Pronase digestion solution.
Incubate at room temperature for (mouse age in days + 15 minutes), max 75 minutes.
Prepare 1% FBS wash: Mix 8.9 ml chilled bubbled ACSF.I, 100 µl FBS, and 1 ml 0.132M Trehalose.

steps.title: Wash and Triturate Cells
steps.instruction: Wash the digested tissue and mechanically dissociate cells.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate digestion solution and dispense 1 ml wash buffer (Papain wash buffer or 1% FBS in ACSF.IT for Pronase).
Repeat wash 3 times total; on the 3rd rinse, add only 0.5 ml and do not aspirate.
If using Papain, place samples on wet ice for 5 minutes.
Prime fire-polished pipettes with ~1 ml wash buffer.
Using the largest pipette, aspirate and dispense the solution + ROIs ~10 times slowly to avoid bubbles.
Repeat trituration with remaining pipettes from largest to smallest until the solution is cloudy with no visible particles.
Store cell suspension on wet ice and proceed to flow cytometer.

steps.title: Cleanup and System Shutdown
steps.instruction: Clean the equipment and dispose of waste.

substeps.instruction: Run 6 ml deionized water through pump tubing, then run air to dry.
Drain compresstome bath and rinse twice with MilliQ water.
Scrape leftover tissue/glue from specimen syringe with a razor and dispose in biohazard bin.
Rinse Styrofoam board, scissors, forceps, needles, and petri dishes with hot water and dry on blue pads.
Rinse fire-polished pipettes with hot water 3-5 times.
Clean anesthesia chamber with MB-10 and dispose of mouse remains in a carcass bag.
Dispose of blades in sharps container and turn off all Isoflurane, Oxygen, and Carbogen valves.
